name: Spec Driven Develop
description: Mandatory default for non-trivial build/add/fix/implement/refactor requests. Chains existing skills through spec-kit's workflow phases (specify, clarify, plan, tasks, implement, verify) without installing spec-kit's CLI. Adapts docs/specs/ convention. Supersedes /plan as the default for multi-step work. Skip trivial edits (<3 files).
author: Lucas Santana
